faq_heading: Quay condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Quay. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Quay, New Westminster: 59 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 16 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Quay fell from 68 in June to 59 in September (−13.2%), and 51 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 13.3% of New Westminster’s 444 condos and townhomes listed.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Quay?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 59 condos and townhomes listed in Quay. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Quay a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Quay had a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Quay from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 51 condos and townhomes sold in Quay over those 4 months, out of 261 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
